tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind every panel, the workbench gutter and the A4 desk. Never a card fill.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Cards, the control panel, the Omni-Search bar, inputs and the A4 sheet itself.

tokens.name: surface-50
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a card: segmented-control track, kbd hints, table header rows.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Brand structure: the sidebar, page titles, the wordmark, solid secondary buttons. Text on page-bg, surface-0, turquoise-100 (≥10:1).

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of navy-900 surfaces; active sidebar item fill. White text on it ≥10:1.

tokens.name: steel-500
tokens.usage: Secondary brand blue from the logo's book pages: section icons, link text on surface-0 (4.9:1). Not for body copy on page-bg (4.3:1).

tokens.name: royal-500
tokens.usage: Focus border, selection outlines, the progress bar, shadow-button tint. Graphic only — 3.7:1 on white, so never small text.

tokens.name: royal-600
tokens.usage: THE generate action: magic button fill (white text 5.2:1), active tab underline, links.

tokens.name: royal-700
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for royal-600; link hover. White text 6.7:1.

tokens.name: turquoise-100
tokens.usage: Magic tint: the Gen-AI badge, an active Horizon toggle, the detected-intent row. Text on it is navy-900.

tokens.name: turquoise-500
tokens.usage: The wand glow — sparkle icons, the live pulse dot, the shimmer highlight, icons on navy-900 (4.9:1). Never text on white (2.4:1).

tokens.name: turquoise-600
tokens.usage: Hover glow of turquoise-500 elements; the second stop of the shimmer sweep.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0, surface-50 and page-bg (≥15:1).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, inactive tabs. 7.5:1 on white, 6.6:1 on page-bg.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and captions on surface-0 (4.8:1); the resting border of inputs and selects (meets 3:1). On page-bg 4.3:1 — use ink-600 there for text.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and A4 ruler ticks only — 2.5:1, never meaningful text.

tokens.name: success-50
tokens.usage: Ground of success notes and the 'Maarif uyumlu' badge.

tokens.name: success-500
tokens.usage: Status dot and check icon beside a word (never colour alone).

tokens.name: success-700
tokens.usage: Success text on success-50 (4.8:1) and surface-0 (5.0:1).

tokens.name: error-50
tokens.usage: Ground of an inline error note.

tokens.name: error-600
tokens.usage: Error text and the invalid-field border (4.8:1 on white); always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: disabled-100
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders and dividers (decorative), disabled control fills, skeleton base.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per screen: the greeting / Omni-Search headline. navy-900.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The brand name beside the logo, and panel titles inside the workbench.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ayarları değiştirin, evrak sağda canlı oluşsun.
styles.usage: All running UI copy. ink-900 or ink-600.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed in fields, selects and the Omni-Search bar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav group titles, tab labels. ink-600 or ink-900.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: A4 · Times New Roman 12 pt · 2,8 sn
styles.usage: Meta lines, badges, kbd hints. ink-500 on surface-0 only.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.sample: 1. DÖNEM FEN BİLİMLERİ DERSİ 1. YAZILI SINAVI
styles.usage: Official MEB document title — 12 pt bold at 96 dpi. Only inside A4Sheet; never UI.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Official document body — 12 pt. Only inside A4Sheet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges, kbd padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, icon-to-label in buttons, label-to-field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input inline padding, nav item padding, tab gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in the control panel; mobile gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between the two workbench panes.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps; A4 sheet outer margin on the desk.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding above the Omni-Search bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd, small buttons, nav items, the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards and the control panel.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: The Omni-Search bar and the hero banner only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, status dots, avatar.

shadow.note: Shadows are tinted with ink-900 (15,30,54), never pure black.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards, the control panel. Two-layer ambient depth; the 28% layer is the diffuse one.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The A4 sheet on the desk, the Omni-Search bar, floating suggestion lists.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Only the one magic (generate) button per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Halo on focused fields, always together with a royal-600 border (the halo alone is too faint).

tokens.name: shadow-error
tokens.usage: Halo on an invalid field, together with an error-600 border.
